Author: CrownedPandaXIV
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description:
Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!

This plugin sends your fleet to the free XIV Fleet Companion app for Windows, which shows it all in one window. Get the app from https://github.com/CrownedPandaXIV/XIVFleetCompanion-Releases

Needs:
• AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json)

Works best with:
• Allagan Tools: bags, retainers' items and FC chests
• FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf): FC houses
• Submarine Tracker: voyage loot

Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team (AutoRetainer), Critical_Impact (Allagan Tools), erdelf (FC Tracker) and Infi (Submarine Tracker) for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
- Try the move first. Settings → Move your fleet has a trial run: it copies your whole fleet and checks every row, exactly as a move does, then undoes it all and says whether the move would work and how long it took. Nothing switches and nothing is kept.
- Restore a backup in the game (Just this PC). The Status page lists the backups, each with Restore. Games can keep running: the fleet is put back in one go and they see it straight away. The backup is checked whole first, and your fleet as it was is backed up before, so a restore can be undone the same way.
- A weekly damage check (Just this PC): SQLite's own check that the fleet file is whole, once a week and on Check now on the Status page. If it ever finds damage, it says which backup to go back to, and daily backups pause so the good ones are kept.
- Tested with a big made-up fleet (100 characters, 400 subs, 800 retainers, 90 days of history, loot and ventures): every page reads in under a third of a second on both a shared database and the fleet file.
